tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Filling of Potholes using Jet Patcher Zone-1 Bengaluru South City Corporation

itemList.description: Repairs to potholes up to 50 mm by using semi dense bituminous concrete in cold mix by using emulsion including marking the potholes/ patches in regular shape and size, Removing loose pockets, Dewatering in potholes, tack coats of 25 Kg/10 Sqm with RS1 emulsion before after laying of mix etc., by use of advanced jet patching technology machine of approved make and specification having capacity 5.50 to 8.00 cubic meters with auxiliary engine with direct drive to heavy duty blower, Rotary Positive auxiliary engine with direct drive to heavy duty blower, Rotary Positive Displacement Blower with direct drive and separate airline silencer. (Capacity 15 PSI, Flow rate 1370 cum/hr.), compacting using plate compactor, cleaning as directed by Engineer in Charge of the work etc. complete (Bitumen 5 Percentage by weight of mix). (Capacity 15 PSI, Flow rate 1370 cum/hr.), compacting using plate compactor, cleaning as directed by Engineer in-Charge of the work etc. complete (Bitumen emulsion RS1 10 Percentage by weight of mix)
